title: NVIDIA · A Message to Our Company
note: November 8 employee letter. Acknowledges infidelity and does not name the other person.
zh: 员工信承认婚姻不忠；没有说明伴侣姓名或承认泄密。

title: NVIDIA · Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors
note: November 8 statement announcing the inquiry and the board’s initial position.
zh: 11月8日董事会当时的初步表态，不能作为最终调查结论。

title: NVIDIA · Statement From the Independent Members of the NVIDIA Board
note: November 10 appointment of Joon H. Kim and Wachtell by the independent directors.
zh: 11月10日独立董事宣布聘请外部律师；确认程序，不提供最终发现。

title: The New York Times · October 29 investigation, syndicated by GV Wire
note: Intelligence allegations and an equipment-purchase estimate from trade records. The intelligence material is not public.
zh: 10月29日《纽约时报》调查转载；关系及情报指称应明确归于报道。

title: 中华人民共和国外交部 · 2026 年 11 月 10 日例行记者会
note: Chinese Foreign Ministry’s denial in the exchange about NVIDIA.
zh: 11月10日外交部回应；证明中国政府否认立场。

title: SEC EDGAR · NVIDIA FY2026 Form 10-K
note: Export-control history, H20 charge, H200 licenses and Note 17 geographic revenue.
zh: 2026财年年报；地域收入与H20费用，财年截至2026年1月25日。

title: MegaSpeed · Official site and November 12 company statement
note: Cloud offerings and November 12 company statement on cooperation and an intended GPU census.
zh: 11月12日公司声明；配合核验及聘请律师安排，并非已完成核查的结果。

title: Reuters · MegaSpeed responds to U.S. inspections
note: November 12 reporting on MegaSpeed’s own compliance and verification statements.
zh: 11月12日报道公司回应及美方核验；公司说法与独立发现分开。

title: U.S. Senator Tom Cotton · October 2025 letter to Commerce
note: Signed October 2025 request to investigate MegaSpeed.
zh: 2025年10月议员致商务部长信；政策担忧与诉求，不是执法裁决。

title: Clerk of the U.S. House · H.R. 2683 vote
note: January 12, 2026 House roll call, 369 to 22.
zh: 众议院2026年1月12日表决记录；不能据此写成法律已颁布。

title: Reuters · NVIDIA faces deepening scrutiny
note: Reports the allegations and verification limits, and estimates the two-session market-cap move.
zh: 11月10日报道及对其他调查的转述；重复引用不增加独立信源数量。

title: U.S. Senate Banking Committee · Warren–Banks joint statement
note: November 9 joint statement explicitly linking the reports to the push for AI Overwatch in the defense bill.
zh: 参议员跨党派声明；确认公开政策立场。

title: SEC EDGAR · NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q
note: Geographic revenue, licensed H200 shipments and charges. Quarter ended July 26, 2026.
zh: 截至2026年7月26日季报；地域收入、H200、附注10及管理层讨论的投资与承诺。

title: CSIS · Jensen Huang on American AI leadership
note: Huang’s public argument about global adoption of U.S. technology and AI leadership.
zh: 黄仁勋在CSIS的公开政策论证；代表其立场，不能独立证明政策效果。

title: U.S. Lobbying Disclosure Act · NVIDIA Q3 2026 LD-2
note: Aggregate in-house lobbying expenses and disclosed issues, with no per-bill allocation.
zh: 2026年第三季度LD-2游说申报；总额215万美元，未按每项法案分配。

title: GovInfo · H.R. 6875, AI Overwatch Act
note: Introduced text and December 2025 filing date.
zh: AI Overwatch法案文本；文本版本和立法进度应与现行法区别。

title: SEC EDGAR · NVIDIA Q2 FY2026 geographic revenue note
note: Old billing-address table and the qualifier for controlled compute billed to Singapore.
zh: 旧地域披露按开票地址；有关新加坡说明仅适用于相应产品子集。

title: SEC EDGAR · NVIDIA Q3 FY2026 Form 10-Q
note: Change to customer-headquarters reporting and recast comparatives.
zh: 2026财年第三季度季报；地域口径变更及可比重列说明。

title: NVIDIA · Q2 FY2027 results and Q3 outlook
note: August Q3 outlook, including its China Data Center compute assumption.
zh: 2027财年二季度业绩及三季度指引；指引早于11月事件，非实际结果。

title: Stock Analysis / S&P Global Market Intelligence · NVDA historical prices
note: Regular-session closes for November 5–11. Period returns calculated by DEX Research.
zh: NVDA日线历史；仅取11月6至12日常规收盘，不混入盘中与盘后。

title: U.S. BIS · May 2025 industry guidance on chip diversion
note: Guidance on end users, data centers, and controls for specified restricted uses.
zh: BIS于2025年5月13日发布的防转运指导；一般指引不是个案认定。

title: NVIDIA · Amended and Restated Bylaws, §32
note: Director voting authority for removal of an officer.
zh: 公司章程第32条等；高管任免与股权、董事任免是不同事项。

title: N.D. California federal court docket, via Justia
note: Case number, parties and November 9 filing date.
zh: Justia公开案卷镜像：案号5:26-cv-13448及立案；未查询完整实时PACER。

title: Kistenmacher v. NVIDIA et al. · Filed complaint, document mirror
note: File-stamped complaint setting out the plaintiff’s allegations.
zh: 起诉书镜像；属于原告指控，不能作为法院事实认定。

title: U.S. Federal Register · H200-class license review rule
note: January 15, 2026 final rule and case-by-case review conditions.
zh: 2026年1月15日联邦公报：H200类许可逐案审查及客户识别等条件。

title: GovInfo · H.R. 2683 as referred in the U.S. Senate
note: Version received and referred in the Senate on January 13, 2026.
zh: 众议院通过后提交参议院的远程接入法案版本；不等于已生效法律。

title: Financial Times Markets · NASDAQ Composite daily history
note: Same-date benchmark for a descriptive comparison with NVDA.
zh: 纳斯达克综合指数历史；用于同一日期窗口的起点及比较。

title: FRED / S&P Dow Jones Indices · S&P 500
note: Same-date S&P 500 benchmark.
zh: FRED转引标普指数；注明数据来源与相同收盘窗口。

title: SEC EDGAR · NVIDIA 2026 proxy statement
note: Beneficial ownership, board independence and lead independent director structure.
zh: 2026年代理声明；持股口径日期3月23日，实益权益包含共享权利。

title: U.S. House Foreign Affairs Democrats · November 9 letter to Commerce
note: Request to pause certain exports and provide details about awareness, licenses and enforcement.
zh: 11月9日民主党议员致商务部函；确认问责诉求，不证明指控成立。

title: SEC EDGAR · NVIDIA Form 8-K, Item 5.02
note: November 12 filing: resignation effective November 11; interim CEO and board chair. Does not disclose investigative findings.
zh: 11月12日提交；确认11日生效的辞任、临时CEO与董事长任命，不披露调查结论。

title: NVIDIA · CEO transition announcement
note: November 12: transition, first board chair and November 17 results schedule. Business-continuity statements are management expectations.
zh: 11月12日：过渡安排、首任董事长及财报日程；业务持续为管理层预期。

title: Singapore MHA · Investigations into Alice Huang and Megaspeed
note: November 12, paragraphs 2–9: domestic declaration inquiry, individual disposition, continuing company inquiry and unresolved onward route.
zh: 11月12日，第2至9段：本国申报调查、个人处理、公司调查状态及尚待核实的后续去向。

title: Malaysia MITI · Megaspeed / Speedmatrix statement
note: November 13, two-page statement: no official clearance; customs inquiry and distinction between imports and controlled onward movements.
zh: 11月13日两页声明：例行走访不构成确认；海关核验及进口与后续流动的规则区别。

title: Reuters · DOJ has not concluded Alice Huang was a spy
note: November 12: reports Attorney General Blanche’s remarks on an FBI inquiry and the absence of a DOJ conclusion.
zh: 11月12日：转述司法部长关于FBI调查和司法部尚无身份结论的公开表态。

title: House Foreign Affairs Committee · Second request to Huang and NVIDIA
note: November 12: committee requests and explicit support for four legislative proposals. Political allegations in the release are attributed positions.
zh: 11月12日：委员会要求及明确推动四项提案；声明中的指控属于议员立场。

title: House committee chairs · Letter to Jensen Huang
note: Signed November 12: proposed December 1 transcribed interview, reply by November 19, conditional subpoena warning.
zh: 11月12日签署：拟12月1日录供、11月19日前回复及有条件传票警告。

title: House committee chairs · Letter to Tim Teter
note: Signed November 12: proposed December 2 transcribed interview; a request, not an attendance record.
zh: 11月12日签署：拟12月2日录供；证明提出要求，不是出席记录。

title: House committee chairs · Invitation to Jeffrey Kessler
note: November 12: invitation for December 3, written confirmation requested by November 19.
zh: 11月12日：拟12月3日听证，要求11月19日前书面确认。

title: Reuters · Chinese AI projects reliant on NVIDIA
note: November 13: review of over 150 documents; mixed project and equipment values, not NVIDIA revenue or a MegaSpeed transaction finding.
zh: 11月13日：核查150余份文件；项目与设备混合口径，不等于英伟达收入或MegaSpeed交易认定。

title: Lettall / Tianjian · 2024 financing inquiry response
note: July 23, 2024; new-business section, printed pages 107–133. Ownership, procurement and leasing disclosures; not proof of every later supply route.
zh: 2024年7月23日，新业务部分，第107至133页：股权、采购与租赁披露，不代表后续全部供货路径。

title: Lettall · 2025-026 reply to annual-report inquiry
note: July 5, 2025, especially printed pages 8–10, 19–25: service model, anonymous Company Seven, annual transactions and prepaid balances.
zh: 2025年7月5日，重点第8至10、19至25页：服务模式、匿名公司七、年度交易及预付款余额。

title: Kharon · Research on Alice Huang and MegaSpeed
note: Third-party matching of anonymous supplier identifiers; treated as a research inference, not issuer confirmation of the name.
zh: 第三方对匿名供应商身份特征的匹配；本文作为推论，未升级为发行人名称确认。

title: Lianhe Zaobao · MegaSpeed financial statements
note: November 2026: registry-based financial reporting. Full financial statements were not obtained independently for this report.
zh: 2026年11月：查阅登记财报后的报道；本文未独立取得完整财报附注。

title: Lianhe Zaobao · Speedmatrix and Apex financing
note: November 13: registered collateral and creditor ownership chain; does not trace every purchase or establish operational control.
zh: 11月13日：登记担保及债权人股权链，不追踪全部采购或证明经营控制。

title: SEC EDGAR · CoreWeave 2025 Form 10-K
note: Financing model: long-term contracts, asset financing and customer prepayments. Industry comparator, not evidence of MegaSpeed terms.
zh: 长期合同、资产融资和客户预付款模式；行业对照，不是MegaSpeed合同证据。

title: SEC EDGAR · CoreWeave September 2025 Form 8-K
note: Filed September 15; September 9 order, Item 1.01: conditional residual-capacity arrangement and NVIDIA’s multiple commercial roles.
zh: 9月15日提交，披露9日订单，1.01项：有条件剩余容量安排及英伟达的多重角色。

title: Taipei City Government · NVIDIA headquarters contract progress
note: November 13: one local project’s contracting and payments; does not establish worldwide business continuity.
zh: 11月13日：当地总部项目签约和付款情况，不代表全球全部项目状态。

title: NVIDIA · Fleet Intelligence technical description
note: May 11, 2026: agent telemetry and supported hardware attestation. Product description, not evidence all historical GPUs are monitored.
zh: 2026年5月11日：代理遥测及部分硬件证明功能；不证明历史销售全部受到监控。

title: Reuters · Senate Banking chair requests testimony
note: November 13: Tim Scott’s oversight request; invitations and possible subpoenas are not completed proceedings.
zh: 11月13日：Tim Scott监督要求；邀请与可能传票不等于已经完成程序。

title: SEC exhibit · NVIDIA and CoreWeave expand partnership
note: January 26, 2026: $2 billion investment and expansion target. Target capacity is not installed capacity.
zh: 2026年1月26日：20亿美元投资及扩张目标；目标容量不是已投运容量。

title: Associated Press · U.S. index closes, November 12, 2026
note: Regular-close index values; used with starting values for the November 6–12 window.
zh: 常规收盘指数；与起始值配对计算11月6至12日变动。

title: Reuters · Malaysia probes possible onward chip exports
note: November 13 update: Prime Minister Anwar said there was then no indication of linked chips leaving Malaysia. Not a final clearance.
zh: 11月13日更新：总理称当时未见相关芯片出境迹象；不构成最终确认。
